preconditions.expression: all(any(x != y and (x, y) in edges or (y, x) in edges for y in range(1, n + 1)) for x in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: The graph is connected, meaning there is a path between any pair of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(x != y for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: There are no self-loops, meaning no edge connects a vertex to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(edges.count((x, y)) <= 1 and edges.count((y, x)) <= 1 for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: There are no multiple edges, meaning each pair of vertices has at most one edge between them.
The number of vertices is between 2 and 2 * 10^5.
The number of edges is between n - 1 and the maximum possible number of edges.
The value of k is between 1 and the maximum possible number of paths.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= w <= 10^9 for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: The weights of the edges are between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: output == sorted(d[i][j] for i in range(1, n + 1) for j in range(i + 1, n + 1) if i != j)[k - 1]
postconditions.description: The output is the length of the k-th smallest shortest path in the graph.
